html:
G'oya

Har bir xodimni o'zining bo'limdoshlari bilan solishtirish kerak. Bunga korrelyatsiyalangan subquery qulay: ichki so'rov tekshirilayotgan xodimning department ini oladi va faqat shu bo'lim bo'yicha AVG(salary) ni hisoblaydi.

Yechim

SELECT id, name, department, salary
FROM employees e
WHERE salary > (
  SELECT AVG(salary)
  FROM employees e2
  WHERE e2.department = e.department
)

Bir jadval ikki xil alias bilan ishlatildi: e tekshirilayotgan xodim, e2 uning bo'limdoshlari. Namunada IT o'rtachasi 7 mln, Savdoniki 5,5 mln, shuning uchun Aziz va Malika chiqadi. Dilnozaning 7 mlni o'rtachaga teng, u kirmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato bo'lim shartini unutish. Unda hamma xodim butun kompaniya o'rtachasi (namunada 6,4 mln) bilan solishtiriladi va Malika o'rniga Dilnoza chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name, department, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)

>= ham xato: bir kishilik bo'limdagi xodim o'rtachaning o'zi va u chiqmasligi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Bo'lim o'rtachalarini bir marta hosila jadvalda hisoblab, xodimlarga ulash mumkin:

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.department, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN (
  SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department
) d ON d.department = e.department
WHERE e.salary > d.avg_salary
